question: snow depth and water equivalent
needed_measurement: automatic snow pillow or ultrasonic depth sensor plus manual density cores, on at least one shaded and one sunny plot
why_satellite_cannot: optical imagery sees the surface, not the depth below it

question: season opening date
needed_measurement: continuous depth record against an operating threshold, over several seasons
why_satellite_cannot: a 5-day revisit with cloud gaps cannot resolve a threshold crossing to the day

question: snowmaking windows
needed_measurement: wet-bulb temperature at the gun line, wind speed and direction, water source yield and temperature, equipment curves, target depth
why_satellite_cannot: none of these quantities is observed from orbit

question: avalanche terrain classification
needed_measurement: snowpack profiles, wind transport and loading patterns, mapped start and runout zones, local forecaster judgement
why_satellite_cannot: slope angle is geometry; release depends on the snowpack

question: real (not clear-sky) irradiance
why_satellite_cannot: the model here is clear-sky by construction; cloud attenuation is unmeasured
